@@name@@Noxious Trap@@icon@@Noxious Trap.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]] after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can happen repeatedly.@@description2@@'''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.@@description3@@The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poison]] to nearby enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 4 seconds, as well as [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealing]] them.@@description4@@'''[[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] poison:''' The target takes magic damage every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.@@description5@@A mushroom has [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 6 '''maximum''' health and can only be damaged by [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] basic attacks (2 damage from [[File:Ranged role.png|20px|link=Ranged|An icon representing the keyword Ranged]] [[:Ranged|ranged]] and 3 from [[File:Melee role.png|20px|link=Melee|An icon representing the keyword Melee]] [[:Melee|melee]]).@@description6@@''See [[Teemo#Pets|Pets]] for more details about mushroom traps.''@@leveling@@

If '''Teemo''' dies before ''Noxious Trap'' bounces on another, the trap will disappear. * [[File:Rift ScuttlerSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Rift Scuttler|An icon representing Rift Scuttler]] [[Rift Scuttler]] will not trigger ''Noxious Trap's'' explosion if it is not being attacked. * Enemies who step on multiple ''Noxious Traps'' will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow. * ''Noxious Trap's'' damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if '''Teemo's''' [[File:Ability power icon.svg|15px|link=Ability power]] ability power changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all ''Noxious Traps'' so long as they do not explode. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.@@
